title: Chapter 152
text:
With both hands on the ground, Han Xiao carried a large pack of wolves on his back. Each wolf weighed a few hundred pounds, and it was very difficult for him to hold up. He quickly rolled away and took out a grenade from his waist, stuffing it under the pack of wolves.

Boom!

With a muffled sound, shrapnel and sparks flew in all directions. The pack of wolves howled in pain, and they were all covered in blood. Han Xiao's armor was also splashed with a smear of blood. He stood up like a salted fish, and with a swipe of his hand, he took out a retractable machete. This was a model that had been strengthened many times, the official version.

Han Xiao agilely moved among the pack of wolves, and the dark glow of the blade flashed continuously, bringing with it a splash of blood. The corrosive venom of the purple-scaled python could not keep up with his pace. With a flash of the blade, the snake's head was chopped off. The cut was as smooth as a mirror, and blood spurted out. The headless snake's body was still twitching on the ground.

All the beasts surrounded him. With the speed of the Electromagnetic Hover-boots, the defense of the Magnetically-Controlled Retractable Armor, and the advantage of his attributes, he could slaughter the entire pack of beasts alone. The players were left with nothing to do, and they watched in shock as Han Xiao went on a killing spree.

Why is a Mechanic fighting hand-to-hand?

The eyes of the players were firmly attracted by Han Xiao's elegant figure. Although they wanted to complain, they could not deny that close combat was really cool. It changed most people's view of the Mechanic class!

It turned out that only long-range shooters were considered Mechanics. Close combat was also very fierce. Furthermore, the close-combat style was very distinct, and it felt completely different from Pugilists.

Mad Blade Angry Sword finally came online. Panting, he arrived outside the town and saw the scene of the beast attack. This was also the first time he saw Han Xiao show off his skills. At this moment, he felt that he had found a guiding light. This was the fighting style that he liked! Just look at his ID!

Choosing to follow Han Xiao was the right choice! Mad Blade Angry Sword almost could not suppress the excitement in his heart. He had really made the right choice back then!

It was not just Mad Blade. Many players who had been affected by the discussions on the forums and were hesitant to change their class had also rekindled their interest in the Mechanic class.

After slaughtering countless wolves and snakes, Han Xiao's field of vision suddenly became empty. He discovered that the pack of wolves was slowly retreating while whimpering. The pack of purple-scaled pythons was also spitting out their tongues and fleeing. Soon, they had all retreated, leaving behind corpses that dyed the soil bright red.

He took a deep breath and wiped off the bloodstains on his armor. With his attributes, he could easily crush these low-level beasts. He only had two-fifths of his stamina left.

Mechanics rarely fought with their enemies in close combat. Occasionally, when he was reckless, he would feel comfortable and relaxed. Compared to using a one-shot killer style, this feeling of punching flesh was more suitable for him to vent his anger.

The guards of Green Valley Town came out to clean up the battlefield and moved the corpses back to the town to store food. Han Xiao rejected Balsas's invitation again. Under the excited gazes of the players, he minded his own business and returned to his original position, pretending to close his eyes and rest.

The interface notified that the mission was completed. He had also killed more than a hundred beasts and received more than 20,000 experience. His level was much higher than the targets he killed, so the experience would be greatly reduced. However, no matter how small a mosquito was, it was still meat. Han Technician was not picky. This was mainly to test his current skills and to have a clear understanding of his own physical attributes. This way, he would be able to pay attention to details in future battles. Another reason was to continue to show the strength of the Mechanic class. He had noticed that the Esper players were shining brightly while the new Mechanic class players were drowning in the crowd. This would probably cause a group of people to doubt him. Thus, he wanted to use his own performance to divert the attention of the players.

Opening the forums, Han Xiao found that a player had uploaded a video of what had just happened. The style of the title was very shocking. "Strong! The Mechanic class can still fight like this! "

The video recorded that Han Xiao had almost single-handedly dealt with a beast attack. The image was very impactful. In the past, he mainly used sniping and killed with one shot. He also used turrets and robots to provide firepower. He did not show his individual combat strength. This time, he made up for it. Most of the comments and replies were in awe.

However, he found that there was another reply at the bottom of the post that had been manually pinned to the top. Looking at the ID, it was that Luzman again. The tone was very harsh.

"Black Phantom is indeed very strong, I don't deny that. However, the Mechanic class is really trash. Pay attention to the beginning of the video. The Espers are the backbone of the battle against the beast horde, while the players who have changed their class to Mechanic class can only shoot from the sidelines. They are completely useless. This video should be recorded by a Mechanic class player. Other than the Mechanics who can only slack off, I don't think the other players have the time to do this during battle …

Also, stop posting videos of Black Phantom. This bastard is trying to trick me into playing the Mechanic class again! "

As he continued reading, the replies were divided into support and opposition.

Han Xiao smacked his lips. He was a little annoyed. Luzman was not letting go of this point and was affecting his business. The players' attention was attracted by the argument, so the effect of him showing his strength was greatly reduced. With Han Xiao's many years of experience in forums, he could immediately tell that Luzman was a war dog. He posted everywhere with a sarcastic and sarcastic tone.

Scratching his head, Han Xiao did not have a good solution to this. This was a debate that was bound to happen. Just like the salty tofu pudding and sweet tofu pudding, as long as one was not allowed to talk, one could not stop others from exercising their right to freedom of speech.

"But I'm an NPC now. Even if my strength is not enough to convince more people, I can't do anything too out of line. I can't run in front of the players and say 'I'm actually a player' …" Han Xiao sighed.

The NPC template was his secret, and he did not want to reveal it. Although from the perspective of the players, seeing an NPC shout 'I am a player' would only be novel and interesting, not many people would take it seriously. Most of them would think that it was an easter egg or character setting, just like Deadpool.

There were also some indescribable training games where the simulated characters would also say that they knew of the existence of players, but who would take it seriously? Those who took it seriously had already been corrected by Yang Technologies.

Before the smell of blood dispersed, Mad Blade, who had been observing from the sidelines for a while, ran over from afar. As soon as he appeared, he attracted the attention of the players. Galaxy Times broadcasted his movements, and Mad Blade became a little famous and was recognized immediately.

The players around whispered and were very envious.

"Isn't this the professional player that the show was talking about? He was shown in the promotional video."

"He does have a special relationship with Black Phantom."

"I also want to trigger Black Phantom's hidden storyline."

Mad Blade came to Han Xiao's side.

Han Xiao valued this candidate with potential. He still had some conscience. He did not mind making Mad Blade look bad in front of the NPCs, but he did not have the heart to do that in front of the players. After all, Mad Blade was a professional player, and his image was still very important.

Han Xiao casually set some normal quests, and Mad Blade was disappointed when he received the quests.

"Gathering resources? So boring, I might as well dance. "

Han Xiao's mouth twitched. Habits were really scary.

At this time, a player with the ID 'Laughing Blade' walked over and said, "Mad Blade?"

Mad Blade's face fell when he saw this person. He said in a low voice, "It's you. You're here to play Galaxy too. Why not play Tale of Wuxia?"

"Hehe, it's not that challenging." Laughing Blade smiled.

Some of the players recognized Laughing Blade.

"Laughing Blade? Isn't he that professional player?"

"I heard that he's in the top three in Tale of Wuxia and has won the championship twice."

Laughing Blade enjoyed the players' exclamations. He looked at Frenzied Sword with a hint of disdain.

Mad Blade used to be a professional player in Tale of Wuxia, but he was defeated by him many times in the competition. His fame was far below Laughing Blade.

Laughing Blade saw Mad Blade's praise in Galaxy Times and realized that his old rival was doing better than him. He felt that it was unfair and purposely came to pick a fight. He did not have good intentions when he took the initiative to greet Mad Blade. After a few words, he pretended to be natural and said, "Since we've met, let's PK. I'm an Esper, what's yours?"

"… Machinery."

Mad Blade was a little hesitant. Although he was riding on Han Xiao's coattails, the early skills of machinery were not suitable for battle, so he subconsciously wanted to reject.

Unexpectedly, Laughing Blade suddenly said, "We've known each other for a few years. Let's have a friendly PK. You won't reject such a small request, right? Or are you looking down on me?"

Mad Blade was speechless. It was hard for him to reject. There was no need to make an enemy out of someone in the same industry over such a small matter.

Laughing Blade laughed coldly in his heart. He was just using words to pressure Frenzied Sword. He was afraid that Frenzied Sword would reject him. Frenzied Sword had gained some popularity in Galaxy, and he wanted to take advantage of it.

Once one gained fame, they would easily become the prey in the eyes of others.

If he defeated Mad Blade, he might be able to reduce his fame. If he defeated a professional player who had been on the show, he would also gain some fame.

Laughing Blade was very confident. His awakened Esper Ability was not bad. The basic application was to gather earth and rocks to form armor on the surface of his body. It was more of a defensive type and was not afraid of guns. He felt that he had a good chance of winning.

Even if he lost, he could test the gap between them. After all, he would not die. Laughing Blade felt that this was a good deal.

Furthermore, he looked at Black Phantom with a burning gaze.
